description: This file is an HTML document that serves as the frontend for a database viewer application. It contains the layout, styles, and JavaScript functions necessary for displaying and interacting with database tables and their data.

methods.name: showLoading
methods.description: Displays a loading message in the specified element.

methods.name: showError
methods.description: Displays an error message in the specified element.

methods.name: showEmptyState
methods.description: Displays an empty state message in the specified element.

methods.name: setActiveState
methods.description: Sets the active state for a given element while removing active states from others.

methods.name: fetchData
methods.description: Fetches data from the given URL and returns it as a JavaScript object.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Loads available databases and populates the database list in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and updates the displayed information.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads tables for a selected database and populates them in the sidebar.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data for a selected table in a selected database.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders a data table in the specified container based on the fetched data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders a table cell based on the value and its type.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content based on user interaction.
